$comment: Every failing step of every failing workflow run of the 13-ticket sample the
decision-workflow eval plan draws its cause split from. Re-derived live from
the jobs API by lane jev-ci-cause-instrumentation-1440 before the sixth reason
code landed, not copied from the plan: 1,635 runs, 102 failing, 141 failing
steps, against a positive control of 1,499 successful runs.
This is a REGRESSION corpus, not a hand-written one. Its job is to prove that
the shipped vocabulary reproduces the measured split over REAL step names, so
a later edit that widens a token and quietly reclassifies 59 evidence-source
refusals as product failures is a red test rather than a review catch.
Two steps are recorded with a note because the plan's prose vocabulary does
not match them and the assignment is a judgement:
'Check for integration tests in PR' -- a coverage gate refusing a missing
integration test, so a missing-artifact refusal. Its only distinctive
substring is 'test', a PRODUCT token, which is why the shipped vocabulary
names the step instead of guessing.
'Refuse when the test shards did not run' -- read as a statement about the
test suite, following the plan's own count. Arguably infrastructure; the
divergence is recorded rather than resolved silently.
